paragraphs.notes: Continuation of the substituent list begun on the preceding page; it starts mid-enumeration with no opening R label. The zh field holds the verbatim German, since this is a German-language WO publication and not Chinese. Printed superscripts are rendered inline: R8, R9, R10, R11, R13, R2 and R2a all carry their digits as superscripts, and the m, n and p in -(CH2)m-, -(CH2)n- and -S-(O)p- are printed as subscripts, as is the 2 in CH2. The double space in 'eine der  Gruppen' is as printed. A small stray ink squiggle sits in the right margin beside the third line; it is a scan artifact, not a character.

paragraphs.notes: Superscript 2a on R. All C-number digits in (C1-C6), (C2-C6) and (C3-C6) are printed as subscripts. Note the printed inconsistency in capitalisation: lower-case 'alkoxy', 'alkenyloxy', 'alkinyloxy' after 'Halogen-' on the first two lines but capitalised 'Alkyl' and 'Alkoxy' after 'Halogen-' on the last line; transcribed as printed.
